name: plugin-builder
description: Scaffold Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Cursor plugins from a single UnifiedSpec.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold and validate Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor plugins from one spec.
interface.longDescription: Plugin Builder creates multi-target Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Cursor plugin trees from a single UnifiedSpec, validates generated plugins, and patches marketplace catalogs.
capabilities: Create hybrid Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor plugin scaffolds
Validate manifests, file structure, cross-references, dry-runs, and marketplace catalogs
Publish plugin entries to Claude, Codex, and Cursor marketplace catalogs
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new plugin for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor
